snippet.title: Drunken Goddess Reflux Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
NEW TITLE ANNOUNCEMENT!
"Drunken Goddess Reflux"
Coming 2026!

Russian Roulette × Drinking Survival × Demon

Face off against a demon who loves you enough to kill you in a high-stakes drinking survival, where it’s spill your soul or make her spill hers.
Break the rules as you drink in this twisted game of Russian roulette. Push the demon past her limits and make her spill everything!

▼ Wishlist Drunken Goddess Reflux on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4150720/ 

■ Staff
Producer & Scenario Writer: WHO YOU (Fuyuki Hayashi)
Art Director / Character Designer / Animator: odyk
Theme Song & BGM: Aiobahn +81
Lead Game Designer: Masatoshi Tokuoka
Programmer: oyatsu
3D Environment: tiri, temi
Background Art: amebiyori
GUI Design: Kaoru Ito
Logo Design: Hiroto Sugawara (femt)
Voice: Nanahira

■ Theme Song
“DEMON’S SHOT”
Composition: Aiobahn +81
Arrangement: Aiobahn +81
Lyrics: DEMONDICE
Vocal: DEMONDICE
